engine.fingerprint.title: Engine capability profile
engine.fingerprint.remediation: The main binary is FairPlay-encrypted, so strings / symbols inside it cannot be read. Provide a decrypted IPA for binary-based detection; this tool never decrypts.

engine.container.unknown.title: Unknown containers analysed
engine.container.unknown.summary: {candidates} large candidate file(s), {analyzed} analysed in depth, {clusters} custom header group(s); {suspicious} look custom or encrypted. Compressed is not encrypted: internal structure decides; conclusions are never stronger than 'suspected'.
engine.container.unknown.remediation: Start with the header evidence (magic, offset table, size field) and index files next to the container, then decide whether the payload is compressed or encrypted.

engine.primary.title: Primary engine: {name}
engine.primary.remediation: The main binary is FairPlay-encrypted: binary-based traits are missing and the verdict relies on files, directories and linked libraries. A decrypted IPA improves accuracy.

engine.custom.title: In-house / modified engine judgement
engine.custom.remediation: Follow the next steps in the report, then record confirmed traits in engines.user.d/<id>.json.

engines.next.header_cluster: {count} files share the custom header {header}: read one small and one large sample and check whether the bytes after the header are a standard format (see the payload evidence).
engines.next.script_vm: Focus on the {vm} bindings / loader in the main binary and check whether scripts on disk are plain text, bytecode or encrypted.
engines.next.python_opcodes: Python bytecode headers are non-standard: expect a customised interpreter (shuffled opcodes); standard disassemblers will not work.
engines.next.shader: No shader files were recognised: confirm the shader format manually (embedded source, runtime-compiled MSL/GLSL or a custom binary).
engines.next.decrypted_ipa: The main binary is FairPlay-encrypted, so symbol / string evidence is missing: provide a decrypted IPA to continue. This tool never decrypts.
engines.next.record_signature: Once traits are confirmed, record them in <user data dir>/engines.user.d/<id>.json so the next run identifies the engine directly.
engines.limited_note: Binary is encrypted: binary-based detection is limited
